Phenomenal, fine Japanese Restaurant!
May 2026 • Couples
Fujiaki is amazingly grrrreat!!!
Super location across from APEX Park on the Han. It is at the head of the Dragon Bridge, so after a scrumptious dinner just cross the street and watch the show (9pm; Friday, Saturday, & Sunday)! The restaurant is quaint and we listened to solo piano, as we arrived before the crowds * We had a very nice veggie soup and large salad, just packed with baby tomatoes, colorful sweet bell peppers and tiny cucumber slices! Superb* our mains were shrimp Tempura and a breaded Katsu Pork - tender and delicious! For desert, watermelon with a sweetened chili powder! All really good* This is a 6 Star joint- you won’t be disappointed- try it and see! The waitstaff (Thanh, our waiter) is very attentive and the lady (Chinh) that made our complicated drinks knows exactly what she’s doing =FIRST CLASS, All-around *
